pending_commit.commit_message: cryptohome: gracefully handle signals. Catches the signal SIGTERM, SIGINT, and SIGHUP by g_unix_signal_add calls so the service can shut down and the program can exit normally. BUG=b:140393018 TEST=restart cryptohomed, check the log. Change-Id: I71f7f37c956c24625fb00f756562b763a428394b Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1782181 Tested-by: Leo Lai <cylai@google.com> Commit-Ready: Leo Lai <cylai@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: John L Chen <zuan@chromium.org>

tpm_manager: correct file dependencies OwnersipTakenCallback currently resides in dbus_service.h As a result, lots of files that needs to know OwnersipTakenCallback have to inlcude dbus_service.h. However, dbus_service.h should be at the bottom of the dependency chain because it "has" the interfaces of those who need to know OwnersipTakenCallback, including TpmManagerService and its parent class. Move OwnersipTakenCallback to a common place so every file can access it. tpm_manager: DBusService able to take ownerhsip of TpmManagerService As part of effort to make tpm_managerd nomally exit, DBusService needs to manage TpmManagerService; however by current design TpmManagerService depends on the command line argument as the constructor parameters. Therefore for now the simplest way is to declare a constructor to take ownership of unique_ptr<TpmManagerService>. BUG=b:132657813 TEST=unittest TEST=tpm_managers is still working. Change-Id: I6aed444a410d608623cfe8dff6c92b0f3170732b Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1782184 Tested-by: Leo Lai <cylai@google.com> Commit-Ready: Leo Lai <cylai@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Wei-Cheng Xiao <garryxiao@chromium.org>

tpm_manager: remove unreachable code in server/main.cc 1. Currently the signals kill the program so there is no chance to execute the part after we leave the main loop. 2. The logic is running w/o main loop even if it's reachable. 3. Considering the purpose of the intended behavior, the case happens very rarely and restarting tpm_managerd can also do the job. Thus, remove it. ml: intermediate CL to make ml-service support load model strings. This is an intermediate CL to upgrade the ml-service API to support loading models from strings. This CL actually does two things: 1. Add a new interface |LoadFlatBufferModel| to accept a model string and load a model from it. 2. Rename |LoadModel| to |LoadBuiltinModel|. The related metadata structs, enums are also renamed by adding "Builtin" to their names. After this CL is merged, there will be another two CLs, 1. A Chromium CL to change the apps/services to use the new APIs. 2. Another ChromeOS CL to remove the old APIs. minigbm: cros_gralloc: handle video decoder flag Although gralloc0 doesn't include a video decoder flag, the IAllocator gralloc0 passthrough gives the lower 32 bits of the BufferUsage flags to gralloc0. This change makes cros_gralloc add the video decoder BO_USE flag when that happens. It also adds some missing combinations for when the BO_USE_HW_VIDEO_DECODER flag is actually set.
